---
title: "Tables"
format: html
---

Builds the published tables and saves them to the gitignored `tables/` folder. The tables carry the paper's labels, applied to copies of the data used only for display, so the labels cannot change a number.

::: {.Rcode title="Source code"}
The full R script is available at:

-   [`R/tables.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/hope-act-education-intervention/blob/master/R/tables.R)

This R script file is itself reliant on the following files:

-   [`R/setup.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/hope-act-education-intervention/blob/master/R/setup.R)
-   [`R/functions.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/hope-act-education-intervention/blob/master/R/functions.R)
-   [`R/process_offers.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/hope-act-education-intervention/blob/master/R/process_offers.R)
-   [`R/process_demographics.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/hope-act-education-intervention/blob/master/R/process_demographics.R)
-   [`R/models.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/hope-act-education-intervention/blob/master/R/models.R)

The code sections below are imported directly from that script when this page is rendered.
:::

```{r}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
#| cache: false
knitr::read_chunk("../R/tables.R")
```
